scientific.integrity: Minimality below six total vertices is proved directly; the exact 3-by-3 class and signature counts are independently replayable by exhaustive row/column permutation canonicalization. Literature searches support, but cannot logically prove, originality.
scientific.limitations: The result proves the minimal boundary and the complete bi-twin-free 3-by-3 census only; it does not classify larger reconstruction fibers. The term bi-twin-free is explicitly defined and not claimed as standard terminology.

title: Dual Dowker complexes first lose a bi-twin-free relation at \(3\times3\)
